name: MineralTenementManager
tagline: Never lose ground: every tenement rent, expenditure report, renewal and heritage clearance in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete plug-and-play tenement management module for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages. Keep the register of exploration licences, prospecting licences and mining leases, see every statutory obligation on a calendar, track expenditure against commitments for each tenement year with shortfall warnings and exemptions, move tenements through grant, renewal and surrender with enforced rules, and know where ground work may proceed from native title and heritage clearances. Works instantly in demo mode and connects to Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel, SQL or the Power Pages Web API without JSON.
features: Obligations from grant anniversaries, expiry, rent due, relinquishment and survey dates
Overdue and due-soon highlighting with one-click actions
Tenement-year expenditure vs commitment with pro-rata expectation and shortfall risk
Tenure lifecycle with rules, reasons, side effects and confirmations
Ground-work readiness from land access and heritage
Bulk rent paid, report lodged, renewal and manager actions
CSV export and statutory report pack action
Outputs and events for Power Fx
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
controlType: standard (2 controls: MineralTenementManager data-set + MineralTenementManagerPortal field control)
